You can also visit my Google Scholar page (upper-right corner).


***

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, comment=FALSE}
a = readLines("pubslist.Rmd", n = -1)
a = a[nzchar(a)]
n = length(a)

k = match("# Published", a)

# #NotYetPrinted 아래에서 # Published 전까지의 항목을 가져옵니다.
notyet = if (k > 2) a[2:(k-1)] else character()
notyet = notyet[trimws(notyet) != "-"]

# 실제 항목이 있을 때만 제목과 목록을 출력합니다.
if (length(notyet) > 0) {
  cat("## Papers, accepted for publication\n\n")
  for (i in seq_along(notyet)) {
    cat(i, ". ", notyet[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```

## Published work

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, comment=FALSE}
k2 = n
for(i in 1:n){if(identical("# WorkinProgress", a[i])){k2 = i;break;}}
#for (i in (k+1):(k2-1)) { 
#  cat(paste(i-2,". ", sep = "", a[i]))
#  cat("\n\n")
#}
number_offset = length(notyet)

for (i in (k + 1):(k2 - 1)) {
  cat(paste(i - k + number_offset, ". ", a[i], sep = ""))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```


## Preprints and work in progress

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, comment=FALSE}
for (i in (k2+1):(n)) {
  cat(paste(i-3,". ", sep = "", a[i]))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
